name: Kekkonsoudanjo
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional marriage consultation agency (Himawari Konkatsu): a notice about consultation hours changing, a first day working reception, an enrollment-fee-and-plan guide, a first time attending a matchmaking party, a comparison of two new-counselor training plans, a column about a friend getting nervous before a first matchmaking party, teaching a new counselor how to advise on writing profiles, an explanation of why the path from matchmaking to marriage looks complicated, a consultation-room-renovation closure notice, a column on tailoring advice to each member's age and experience, a notice of revised membership rules, an essay on remembering a first written profile, and a one-year cooperation report on a local marriage-support event. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
